scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: A person operating a motor vehicle on a road.
A vehicle maneuver to change direction to the left or right.
Turning right while the red signal is on, after stopping behind the intersection guides, unless turning is specifically prohibited.
To allow another vehicle or roadway user to proceed first.
The privilege of having immediate use of a certain part of a road.
A person riding a bicycle, a human-powered device with two tandem wheels either of which is more than 14 inches in diameter.
A motor vehicle, other than a tractor, equipped with a rider's saddle and designed to have not more than three wheels on the ground when propelled.
The center lane of a road that is used only by vehicles turning left.
A one-way, circular intersection where traffic flows counterclockwise around a center island and entry is controlled by yield signs.

rules.title: Right turn on steady red
rules.when: facing a steady red light AND the DRIVER has stopped before entering the crosswalk or intersection
rules.action: make a RIGHT TURN ON RED
rules.unless: a TURN is prohibited by law
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady red light AND the DRIVER has stopped before entering the crosswalk or intersection, the DRIVER MAY make a RIGHT TURN ON RED, UNLESS a TURN is prohibited by law.

rules.title: Left turn on red between one-way streets
rules.when: facing a steady red light AND both streets are one-way AND the DRIVER has stopped before entering the crosswalk or intersection
rules.action: TURN left
rules.unless: a TURN is prohibited by law
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady red light AND both streets are one-way AND the DRIVER has stopped before entering the crosswalk or intersection, the DRIVER MAY TURN left, UNLESS a TURN is prohibited by law.

rules.title: Yield when turning on red
rules.when: making a TURN on a steady red light
rules.action: YIELD to all PEDESTRIANS and other traffic lawfully using the intersection
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN on a steady red light, the DRIVER MUST YIELD to all PEDESTRIANS and other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

rules.title: Flashing yellow arrow allows left turn
rules.when: facing a flashing yellow arrow for left TURNS
rules.action: TURN left
rules.statement: WHEN facing a flashing yellow arrow for left TURNS, the DRIVER MAY TURN left.
rules.note: The yield obligation that goes with this permission is TURN-SIG-05.

rules.title: Flashing yellow arrow: yield to oncoming traffic
rules.when: turning left on a flashing yellow arrow
rules.action: YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY to oncoming traffic
rules.statement: WHEN turning left on a flashing yellow arrow, the DRIVER MUST YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY to oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Turning on steady green
rules.when: facing a steady green light AND it is safe to do so
rules.action: TURN, including TURN left
rules.unless: a TURN is prohibited by another sign or signal
rules.statement: WHEN facing a steady green light AND it is safe to do so, the DRIVER MAY TURN, including TURN left, UNLESS a TURN is prohibited by another sign or signal.

vague_terms.term: it is safe to do so

rules.note: A left TURN on green still requires yielding to traffic from the opposite direction (TURN-LT-05).

rules.title: Green arrow with red light
rules.when: a green arrow is displayed at the same time as a red light
rules.action: proceed carefully in the direction of the arrow after the DRIVER YIELDS the RIGHT-OF-WAY to other vehicles and PEDESTRIANS
rules.statement: WHEN a green arrow is displayed at the same time as a red light, the DRIVER MAY proceed carefully in the direction of the arrow after the DRIVER YIELDS the RIGHT-OF-WAY to other vehicles and PEDESTRIANS.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific behaviour or speed given

rules.title: Caution on protected green arrow
rules.when: making a TURN at a protected green arrow signal
rules.action: use caution
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN at a protected green arrow signal, the DRIVER SHOULD use caution.
rules.note: The handbook says that oncoming traffic must stop while the arrow is shown. Taken from a sign table row whose image is missing.

rules.title: Left turn signal sign
rules.when: a sign indicates that a green signal controls left TURNS
rules.action: TURN left when the green signal is displayed
rules.statement: WHEN a sign indicates that a green signal controls left TURNS, the DRIVER MAY ONLY TURN left when the green signal is displayed.
rules.note: The text reads 'A green signal will indicate when you may turn left.' The sign image is missing, so its exact wording is unknown.

rules.title: Turn only in arrow direction
rules.when: wishing to TURN at an intersection where a sign with a turn arrow is posted
rules.action: TURN only in the direction indicated by the arrow
rules.statement: WHEN wishing to TURN at an intersection where a sign with a turn arrow is posted, the DRIVER MUST TURN only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
rules.note: This is a regulatory sign (6.115). The sign image is missing.

rules.title: Double left-turn: left lane must turn
rules.when: driving in the left lane where a sign indicates two lanes of traffic are permitted to TURN left
rules.action: TURN left
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the left lane where a sign indicates two lanes of traffic are permitted to TURN left, the DRIVER MUST TURN left.
rules.note: The sign image is missing.

rules.title: Double left-turn: other lane has a choice
rules.when: driving in the other lane where a sign indicates two lanes of traffic are permitted to TURN left
rules.action: choose whether to TURN left
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the other lane where a sign indicates two lanes of traffic are permitted to TURN left, the DRIVER MAY choose whether to TURN left.
rules.note: The handbook says 'traffic in the other lane has a choice' and does not list the alternatives. The sign image is missing.

rules.title: No left turn sign
rules.when: at an intersection where a no-left-turn sign is posted
rules.action: TURN left
rules.statement: WHEN at an intersection where a no-left-turn sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT TURN left.
rules.note: The sign image is missing. The text says turning left where 'this sign' is posted is prohibited.

rules.title: No U-turn sign
rules.when: at an intersection where a no-U-turn sign is posted
rules.action: make a U-turn
rules.statement: WHEN at an intersection where a no-U-turn sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-turn.
rules.note: The sign image is missing. This is the only U-turn rule in the handbook.

rules.title: Right lane must turn right
rules.when: driving in the right lane where a right-lane-must-turn-right sign is posted
rules.action: TURN right at the next intersection
rules.unless: the sign indicates a different turning point
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the right lane where a right-lane-must-turn-right sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST TURN right at the next intersection, UNLESS the sign indicates a different turning point.
rules.note: The sign image is missing.

rules.title: No turning across double white lines
rules.when: there is a pavement marking of double solid white lines
rules.action: TURN across the double white lines
rules.statement: WHEN there is a pavement marking of double solid white lines, the DRIVER MUST NOT TURN across the double white lines.
rules.note: 6.139 words this as advice ('should not change lanes or turn across'). 6.211 says crossing double solid white lines is prohibited, and that stronger wording is recorded here.

rules.title: When to enter center left-turn lane
rules.when: preparing to TURN left from a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: enter the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.unless: at a point where the vehicle will have time to slow down or stop to make a safe left TURN
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN left from a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT enter the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE, UNLESS at a point where the vehicle will have time to slow down or stop to make a safe left TURN.

vague_terms.term: time to slow down or stop

rules.note: Stated in both a sign description and a pavement-marking section.

rules.title: Center left-turn lane only for left turns
rules.when: driving on a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a road with a CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT use the CENTER LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a through-traffic lane.
rules.note: Both passages use 'should never'.

rules.title: Watch for turning markings and signs
rules.when: preparing to TURN
rules.action: watch for pavement markings and signs that permit turning right or left from or into two or more traffic lanes or give other special turning or lane information
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN, the DRIVER MUST watch for pavement markings and signs that permit turning right or left from or into two or more traffic lanes or give other special turning or lane information.

rules.title: T-intersection ahead
rules.when: approaching a T intersection indicated by a warning sign
rules.action: TURN left or right and be prepared to YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY at the intersection if necessary
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a T intersection indicated by a warning sign, the DRIVER MUST TURN left or right and be prepared to YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY at the intersection if necessary.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when yielding is needed

rules.note: The sign image is missing. 'Must turn' is from the sign description. 5.23 separately requires stopping and yielding to through traffic at a T-intersection.

rules.title: Always signal turns
rules.when: going to make a TURN
rules.action: signal
rules.statement: WHEN going to make a TURN, the DRIVER MUST signal.

rules.title: Signal at least 100 feet before turning
rules.when: approaching the point of a TURN
rules.action: signal continuously for at least 100 feet before turning
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the point of a TURN, the DRIVER MUST signal continuously for at least 100 feet before turning.
rules.note: Also stated as step 4 of a safe turn.

rules.title: Cancel signal after turn
rules.when: a TURN is complete
rules.action: turn off the signal lights
rules.statement: WHEN a TURN is complete, the DRIVER MUST turn off the signal lights.
rules.note: The handbook explains that an unintended signal still means 'turn' to other drivers.

rules.title: Signal lights or hand signals
rules.when: signaling a TURN
rules.action: use either turn signal lights or hand and arm signals
rules.statement: WHEN signaling a TURN, the DRIVER MAY use either turn signal lights or hand and arm signals.

rules.title: Signals visible and timely
rules.when: signaling a TURN
rules.action: make sure the signal can be easily seen by others and signal in plenty of time, extending the hand and arm well out of the car window if using hand signals
rules.statement: WHEN signaling a TURN, the DRIVER MUST make sure the signal can be easily seen by others and signal in plenty of time, extending the hand and arm well out of the car window if using hand signals.

vague_terms.explanation: no time given beyond the 100 feet minimum

rules.note: The hand-signal diagram is missing.

rules.title: Hold hand signal until close to intersection
rules.when: using a hand signal for a TURN
rules.action: hold the signal until close enough to the intersection for others to know the DRIVER's intention
rules.statement: WHEN using a hand signal for a TURN, the DRIVER MUST hold the signal until close enough to the intersection for others to know the DRIVER's intention.

rules.title: Don't hold hand signal while turning
rules.when: making a TURN after giving a hand signal
rules.action: hold the hand signal during the TURN
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN after giving a hand signal, the DRIVER MUST NOT hold the hand signal during the TURN.
rules.note: The handbook's reason is that both hands are needed on the wheel.

rules.title: Signal lights working for non-daylight
rules.when: driving during non-daylight hours
rules.action: make sure the signal lights are working properly
rules.statement: WHEN driving during non-daylight hours, the DRIVER SHOULD make sure the signal lights are working properly.
rules.note: The handbook's reason is that hand and arm signals are hard to see during non-daylight hours.

rules.title: No last-minute turns
rules.when: approaching a turning point
rules.action: make a last minute TURN, and must decide on the TURN before reaching the turning point
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a turning point, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a last minute TURN, and must decide on the TURN before reaching the turning point.

rules.title: Look before changing lanes for a turn
rules.when: changing lanes to prepare for a TURN
rules.action: look behind and to both sides to see where other vehicles are before changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to prepare for a TURN, the DRIVER MUST look behind and to both sides to see where other vehicles are before changing lanes.

rules.title: Get into the proper lane early
rules.when: preparing to TURN
rules.action: move into the proper lane as soon as possible, and sooner the faster the traffic is moving
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN, the DRIVER MUST move into the proper lane as soon as possible, and sooner the faster the traffic is moving.
rules.note: The 'sooner when traffic is faster' part is worded as 'should' in the handbook.

rules.title: Wrong lane: continue straight
rules.when: the DRIVER cannot get into the proper lane within one-half block before the TURN
rules.action: TURN, and must continue straight ahead
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER cannot get into the proper lane within one-half block before the TURN, the DRIVER MUST NOT TURN, and must continue straight ahead.

rules.title: Slow before turning
rules.when: about to make a TURN
rules.action: slow down to a reasonable turning speed before making the TURN
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a TURN, the DRIVER MUST slow down to a reasonable turning speed before making the TURN.

rules.title: No brake or clutch while turning
rules.when: making a TURN
rules.action: use the brake or clutch while turning
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the brake or clutch while turning.

rules.title: Stay in proper turn lane
rules.when: making a TURN
rules.action: stay in the proper turn lane at all times
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN, the DRIVER MUST stay in the proper turn lane at all times.

rules.title: Finish turn in proper lane
rules.when: completing a TURN
rules.action: finish the TURN in the proper lane
rules.statement: WHEN completing a TURN, the DRIVER MUST finish the TURN in the proper lane.

rules.title: Move to far right lane
rules.when: preparing to TURN right
rules.action: signal for a lane change well ahead of the turning point and, when it is safe, move the vehicle to the far right lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN right, the DRIVER MUST signal for a lane change well ahead of the turning point and, when it is safe, move the vehicle to the far right lane.

rules.title: Right signal and slow 100 feet before
rules.when: approaching a corner to TURN right
rules.action: use the right turn signal and slow down at least 100 feet from the corner
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a corner to TURN right, the DRIVER MUST use the right turn signal and slow down at least 100 feet from the corner.

rules.title: Look both ways before right turn
rules.when: about to start a right TURN
rules.action: look both ways before starting to TURN
rules.statement: WHEN about to start a right TURN, the DRIVER MUST look both ways before starting to TURN.

rules.title: Keep close to right edge
rules.when: making a right TURN
rules.action: keep as close as possible to the right edge of the road
rules.statement: WHEN making a right TURN, the DRIVER MUST keep as close as possible to the right edge of the road.

rules.title: Both hands on wheel
rules.when: making a TURN
rules.action: TURN using both hands on the wheel
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN, the DRIVER MUST TURN using both hands on the wheel.
rules.note: Stated in the right-turn steps, and also as the reason for not holding a hand signal during a turn (7.61).

rules.title: Move to center lane for left turn
rules.when: preparing to TURN left
rules.action: signal for a lane change well ahead of the turning point and, when it is safe, move into the center lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN left, the DRIVER MUST signal for a lane change well ahead of the turning point and, when it is safe, move into the center lane.

vague_terms.explanation: which lane is meant depends on the road layout

rules.title: Left signal and slow 100 feet before
rules.when: approaching a corner to TURN left
rules.action: use the left turn signal and slow down at least 100 feet from the corner
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a corner to TURN left, the DRIVER MUST use the left turn signal and slow down at least 100 feet from the corner.

rules.title: Look all directions before left turn
rules.when: about to start a left TURN
rules.action: look in all directions before starting to TURN
rules.statement: WHEN about to start a left TURN, the DRIVER MUST look in all directions before starting to TURN.

rules.title: Stay right of center line entering
rules.when: entering an intersection to TURN left
rules.action: stay to the right of the center line
rules.statement: WHEN entering an intersection to TURN left, the DRIVER MUST stay to the right of the center line.

rules.title: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left
rules.when: turning left, including on a green light
rules.action: YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction
rules.statement: WHEN turning left, including on a green light, the DRIVER MUST YIELD the RIGHT-OF-WAY to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction.
rules.penalty: Failure to yield causing bodily injury: fine of $500 to $2,000; causing serious bodily injury: fine of $1,000 to $4,000.
rules.note: Stated three times: 'always yield' in 5.18, 'must yield' in 6.24 and 'Yield' in 7.75. The stronger 'must' wording is recorded. The penalty comes from the general failure-to-yield table.

rules.title: Complete left turn in least-interference lane
rules.when: completing a left TURN
rules.action: TURN to the right of the center line of the road being entered, into the lane in which the DRIVER will interfere the least with other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN completing a left TURN, the DRIVER SHOULD TURN to the right of the center line of the road being entered, into the lane in which the DRIVER will interfere the least with other traffic.

vague_terms.explanation: no criterion for choosing the lane

rules.title: Change lanes after left turn
rules.when: a left TURN has been completed
rules.action: signal and change lanes if necessary
rules.statement: WHEN a left TURN has been completed, the DRIVER MAY signal and change lanes if necessary.

rules.title: Turning from a one-way road
rules.when: preparing to TURN from a one-way road
rules.action: move into the lane closest to the TURN well in advance of the TURN
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to TURN from a one-way road, the DRIVER MUST move into the lane closest to the TURN well in advance of the TURN.

rules.title: Left from one-way onto two-way
rules.when: turning left from a one-way street onto a two-way street
rules.action: TURN from the left lane into the right lane moving in the same direction
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from a one-way street onto a two-way street, the DRIVER SHOULD TURN from the left lane into the right lane moving in the same direction.
rules.note: The diagram is missing.

rules.title: Left from two-way onto one-way
rules.when: turning left onto a one-way street
rules.action: enter the street in the lane in which the DRIVER will interfere the least with other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN turning left onto a one-way street, the DRIVER MUST enter the street in the lane in which the DRIVER will interfere the least with other traffic.

vague_terms.explanation: no criterion for choosing the lane

rules.note: The diagram is missing.

rules.title: Second look for motorcycles
rules.when: about to TURN at an intersection, particularly a left TURN
rules.action: take a second look for a MOTORCYCLE before turning
rules.statement: WHEN about to TURN at an intersection, particularly a left TURN, the DRIVER MUST take a second look for a MOTORCYCLE before turning.
rules.note: The handbook notes that the most common car-motorcycle crash is a car turning left in front of a motorcycle.

rules.title: Look for motorcyclists on left turns
rules.when: making a left TURN across lanes of approaching traffic
rules.action: look carefully in all directions for approaching MOTORCYCLES
rules.statement: WHEN making a left TURN across lanes of approaching traffic, the DRIVER MUST look carefully in all directions for approaching MOTORCYCLES.

rules.title: Don't trust motorcycle turn signals
rules.when: a MOTORCYCLE shows a flashing turn signal AND the DRIVER intends to proceed
rules.action: wait to be sure the MOTORCYCLE is going to TURN before proceeding
rules.statement: WHEN a MOTORCYCLE shows a flashing turn signal AND the DRIVER intends to proceed, the DRIVER MUST wait to be sure the MOTORCYCLE is going to TURN before proceeding.
rules.note: The handbook's reason is that motorcycle signals are usually not self-canceling.

rules.title: Merge with bicycle traffic for right turn
rules.when: preparing for a right TURN with bicycle traffic nearby
rules.action: slow down and merge with the bicycle traffic
rules.statement: WHEN preparing for a right TURN with bicycle traffic nearby, the DRIVER SHOULD slow down and merge with the bicycle traffic.

rules.title: Don't turn across bicycle path
rules.when: making a TURN with bicycle traffic nearby
rules.action: TURN directly across the path of bicycle traffic
rules.statement: WHEN making a TURN with bicycle traffic nearby, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT TURN directly across the path of bicycle traffic.

rules.title: Watch for oncoming cyclists on left turns
rules.when: turning left at an intersection
rules.action: be on the lookout for oncoming CYCLISTS and their speed
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an intersection, the DRIVER MUST be on the lookout for oncoming CYCLISTS and their speed.
rules.note: Inferred from the instruction to watch for cyclists at intersections (10.186), combined with the common crash of a motorist turning left in front of overlooked or misjudged oncoming bicycle traffic (10.187).

rules.title: Don't pass a possibly right-turning truck on the right
rules.when: there is a possibility a truck ahead might make a right TURN
rules.action: pass the truck on the right
rules.statement: WHEN there is a possibility a truck ahead might make a right TURN, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the truck on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no cue given beyond paying attention to turn signals

rules.note: The handbook explains that trucks make wide right turns and may leave an open space on the right. It also says to pay attention to turn signals.

rules.title: Cyclist right-turn signal
rules.when: about to TURN right
rules.action: signal using either the left arm pointing up or the right arm pointed horizontally
rules.statement: WHEN about to TURN right, the CYCLIST MUST signal using either the left arm pointing up or the right arm pointed horizontally.

rules.title: Cyclist left-turn signal
rules.when: about to TURN left
rules.action: signal using the left arm pointed horizontally
rules.statement: WHEN about to TURN left, the CYCLIST MUST signal using the left arm pointed horizontally.

rules.title: Cyclist may leave right edge for left turn
rules.when: preparing for a left TURN at an intersection or onto a private road or driveway
rules.action: leave the right curb or edge of the road and take the full lane
rules.statement: WHEN preparing for a left TURN at an intersection or onto a private road or driveway, the CYCLIST MAY leave the right curb or edge of the road and take the full lane.
rules.note: Stated as an exception to the duty to ride near the right edge.

rules.title: Cyclist follows vehicle path for left turn
rules.when: changing lanes to make a left TURN
rules.action: follow the same path any other vehicle would take traveling in the same direction
rules.statement: WHEN changing lanes to make a left TURN, the CYCLIST SHOULD follow the same path any other vehicle would take traveling in the same direction.

rules.title: Exit roundabout with right turn and signal
rules.when: exiting a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: make a right TURN using the turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN exiting a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST make a right TURN using the turn signal.
